55:    Main-Pane:
56:
57:    A main pane that contains a single window takes up a vertical portion of
58:    the screen_rect based on the ratio setting. This ratio can be adjusted with
59:    the ``grow_main`` and ``shrink_main`` or, while the main pane is in
60:    focus, ``grow`` and ``shrink``. You may also set the ratio directly
61:    with ``set_ratio``.

63:    ::
64:
65:        ---------------------
66:        |            |      |
67:        |            |      |
68:        |            |      |
69:        |            |      |
70:        |            |      |
71:        |            |      |
72:        ---------------------
73:
74:    Using the ``flip`` method will switch which horizontal side the main
75:    pane will occupy. The main pane is considered the "top" of the stack.
76:
77:    ::
78:
79:        ---------------------
80:        |      |            |
81:        |      |            |
82:        |      |            |
83:        |      |            |
84:        |      |            |
85:        |      |            |
86:        ---------------------
87:
88:    Secondary-panes:
89:
90:    Occupying the rest of the screen_rect are one or more secondary panes.  The
91:    secondary panes will share the vertical space of the screen_rect however
92:    they can be resized at will with the ``grow`` and ``shrink``
93:    methods.  The other secondary panes will adjust their sizes to smoothly fill
94:    all of the space.
95:
96:    ::
97:
98:        ---------------------          ---------------------
99:        |            |      |          |            |______|
100:        |            |______|          |            |      |
101:        |            |      |          |            |      |
102:        |            |______|          |            |      |
103:        |            |      |          |            |______|
104:        |            |      |          |            |      |
105:        ---------------------          ---------------------
106:
107:    Panes can be moved with the ``shuffle_up`` and ``shuffle_down``
108:    methods. As mentioned the main pane is considered the top of the stack;
109:    moving up is counter-clockwise and moving down is clockwise.
110:
111:    ::
112:
113:        ---------------------          ---------------------
114:        |            |      |          |            |      |
115:        |            |______|          |            |Focus |
116:        |            |      |          |            |      |
117:        |            |______|          |            |______|
118:        |            |      |          |            |______|
119:        |            |      |          |            |      |
120:        ---------------------          ---------------------
121:
122:    Setting ``auto_maximize`` will cause the focused secondary pane to be
123:    automatically maximized on focus. The non-maximized panes will shrink to
124:    the height specified by ``min_secondary_size``.
125:
126:    The opposite is true if the layout is "flipped".

129:
130:        ---------------------          ---------------------
131:        |            |  2   |          |   2   |           |
132:        |            |______|          |_______|           |
133:        |            |  3   |          |   3   |           |
134:        |     1      |______|          |_______|     1     |
135:        |            |  4   |          |   4   |           |
136:        |            |      |          |       |           |
137:        ---------------------          ---------------------

143:    use the ``normalize`` method.
144:
145:    To reset all client windows to their default sizes, including the primary

147:
148:    Maximizing:
149:
150:    To toggle a client window between its minimum and maximum sizes

157:        Key([modkey], "j", lazy.layout.down()),
158:        Key([modkey], "k", lazy.layout.up()),

164:        Key([modkey], "m", lazy.layout.shrink()),
165:        Key([modkey], "n", lazy.layout.reset()),
166:        Key([modkey, "shift"], "n", lazy.layout.normalize()),
167:        Key([modkey], "o", lazy.layout.maximize()),
168:        Key([modkey, "shift"], "s", lazy.layout.toggle_auto_maximize()),
169:        Key([modkey, "shift"], "space", lazy.layout.flip()),
